```{r}
# Path to Reactome hierarchy file
reactome_hierarchy <- file.path(PROJECTPATH,  "data/enrichment/reactome_hierarchy.csv")

# Import Reactome hierarchy
df_reactome_hierarchy <- read_csv(reactome_hierarchy, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Initialize tree levels for root pathways
df_reactome_hierarchy <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
  mutate(level = ifelse(is.na(ParentID), 0, NA))

# Iterate lvl down the tree
nmissing <- sum(is.na(df_reactome_hierarchy$level))
lvl <- 0
while (nmissing > 0) {
  
  df_reactome_lvl <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
    filter(level == lvl)
  
  # Iterate over nodes at given level
  for (i in 1:nrow(df_reactome_lvl)){
    
    node <- df_reactome_lvl[[i, "Name"]]
    
    df_reactome_hierarchy <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
      mutate(level = ifelse(is.na(Parent), 0, 
                            ifelse(Parent == node, lvl+1, level)))
    
  }
  
  nmissing <- sum(is.na(df_reactome_hierarchy$level))
  lvl <- lvl + 1
  
}

# Clean up names
df_reactome_hierarchy <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
  mutate(Name = str_replace_all(Name, "  ", " "),
         Name = str_replace_all(Name, "/", " "))
```

```{r}
# Bader Reactome gene sets
module_file <- file.path(PROJECTPATH,  "data/enrichment/Human_Reactome_June_01_2025_symbol.gmt")

# Import Bader sets
df_modules <- get_module_sizes(modules = module_file)

# Clean up IDs
df_modules <- df_modules %>% 
  rename(IDBader = ID) %>% 
  mutate(ID = IDBader %>% 
           str_split_i("%", i = -1) %>% 
           str_remove("R-HSA-") %>% 
           str_remove("\\.[0-9]+"),
         ID = paste0("R-HSA-", ID)) %>% 
  mutate(Title = str_replace_all(Title, "  ", " "))

# Include hierarchy information
df_reactome <- inner_join(df_reactome_hierarchy,
                          df_modules,
                          by = "ID")

# Pathways to keep
pathway_ids_keep <- df_reactome %>% 
  filter(B > 10) %>% 
  pull(IDBader)
```

```{r}
import_enrichment_permutation <- function(file, nk_select, k_select, pathway_ids_keep, pathway_title) {
  
    df_permutation <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    df_permutation$seed <- file |> 
      basename() |> 
      str_extract("seed_[0-9]+") |> 
      str_remove("seed_") |> 
      as.numeric()
    
    df_permutation <- df_permutation |> 
      filter(nk == nk_select, k == k_select) |> 
      filter(ID %in% pathway_ids_keep) |> 
      filter(Title == pathway_title)
    
    return(df_permutation)
  }



import_permutations_parallel <- function(
    files, nk_select, k_select, pathway_ids_keep, pathway_title,
    workers = 4L
) {
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(workers)
  on.exit({
    parallel::stopCluster(cl)
    foreach::registerDoSEQ()
  }, add = TRUE)

  doParallel::registerDoParallel(cl)

  results <- foreach(
    file = files,
    .packages = c("readr", "dplyr", "stringr"),
    .export = "import_enrichment_permutation"
  ) %dopar% {
    import_enrichment_permutation(
      file = file,
      nk_select = nk_select,
      k_select = k_select,
      pathway_ids_keep = pathway_ids_keep,
      pathway_title = pathway_title
    )
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}
```

```{r}

import_enrichment_stat <- function(file, ids, stat = "E") {
  
  
  df <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  df <- df |>
    filter(ID %in% ids)
  
  df <- df |> 
    unite(col = "cluster_id", c("nk", "k"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE)
  
  cluster_lvls <- df |> 
    select(nk, k, cluster_id) |> 
    distinct() |> 
    arrange(nk, k) |>
    pull(cluster_id)
  
  df <- df |> 
    mutate(cluster_id = factor(cluster_id, levels = cluster_lvls))
  
  cols <- c("ID", "cluster_id", stat)
  df <- df[,cols]
  
  mat <- df |> 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = all_of(stat)) |> 
    arrange(ID) |> 
    column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
    as.matrix()
  
  return(mat)
  
}


import_enrichment_stat_parallel <- function(
    files, ids, stat = "E",
    workers = 4L
) {
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(workers)
  on.exit({
    parallel::stopCluster(cl)
    foreach::registerDoSEQ()
  }, add = TRUE)
  
  doParallel::registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  results <- foreach(
    file = files,
    .packages = c("tidyverse"),
    .export = "import_enrichment_stat"
  ) %dopar% {
    mat <- import_enrichment_stat(
      file = file,
      ids = ids, 
      stat = stat
    )
  }
  
  enrichment_array <- simplify2array(results)
  
  return(enrichment_array)
}
```

```{r}
run <- FALSE
if (run) {
permutation_array_E <- import_enrichment_stat_parallel(files = permutation_files,
                                                      ids = pathway_ids_keep, 
                                                      stat = "E", 
                                                      workers = 32L)

saveRDS(permutation_array_E, file = file.path(enrichment_dir, "permutation_array_E.rds"))

permutation_array_NLQ <- import_enrichment_stat_parallel(files = permutation_files,
                                                        ids = pathway_ids_keep, 
                                                        stat = "NLQ", 
                                                        workers = 32L)
} else {
  permutation_array_E <- readRDS(file = file.path(enrichment_dir, "permutation_array_E.rds"))
}
```

```{r}
enrichment_file <- "cluster_pathway_enrichment.csv"
enrichment_file <- file.path(enrichment_dir, enrichment_file)
df_enrichment <- read_csv(enrichment_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

df_enrichment <- df_enrichment |>
  filter(ID %in% pathway_ids_keep)

df_enrichment <- df_enrichment |> 
  unite(col = "cluster_id", c("nk", "k"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE)

cluster_lvls <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(nk, k, cluster_id) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  arrange(nk, k) |>
  pull(cluster_id)

df_enrichment <- df_enrichment |> 
  mutate(cluster_id = factor(cluster_id, levels = cluster_lvls))

mat_enrichment_E <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, E) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "E") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()

mat_enrichment_pvals <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, P.Value) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "P.Value") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()

mat_enrichment_pvals_clamped <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, P.Value) |> 
  mutate(P.Value = ifelse(P.Value < 1/1001, 1/1001, P.Value)) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "P.Value") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()

mat_enrichment_qvals <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, adj.P.Val) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "adj.P.Val") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()

mat_enrichment_NLQ <- df_enrichment |> 
  select(ID, cluster_id, NLQ) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "NLQ") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()

mat_enrichment_qvals_clamped <-  df_enrichment |> 
  mutate(P.Value = ifelse(P.Value < 1/1001, 1/1001, P.Value)) |>
  group_by(cluster_id) |>
  mutate(q.value = p.adjust(P.Value, method = "fdr")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(ID, cluster_id, q.value) |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "ID", names_from = "cluster_id", values_from = "q.value") |> 
  arrange(ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames("ID") |> 
  as.matrix()
```



```{r}
array_enrichment_E <- array(
  rep(as.vector(mat_enrichment_E), times = dim(permutation_array_E)[3]),
  dim = dim(permutation_array_E)
)

permutation_pvals <- (rowSums(permutation_array_E >= array_enrichment_E, dims = 2) + 1)/(dim(permutation_array_E)[3] + 1)

permutation_qvals <- apply(permutation_pvals, MARGIN = 2, FUN = p.adjust, method = "BH")

permutation_NLQ <- -log10(permutation_qvals)

min(permutation_qvals, na.rm = TRUE)
min(permutation_pvals, na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r}
# df_comparison <- tibble(pvals_HG = as.numeric(mat_enrichment_pvals[,1:2]),
                        # pvals_permute = as.numeric(permutation_pvals[,1:2]))

df_comparison <- tibble(pvals_HG = as.numeric(mat_enrichment_pvals),
                        pvals_permute = as.numeric(permutation_pvals))

plt_null_pvals <- ggplot(df_comparison, aes(x = -log10(pvals_HG), y = -log10(pvals_permute))) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.2) + 
  # geom_abline(slope = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10)) + 
  labs(x = "Hypergeometric Test p-value (-log10)",
  y = "Permutation p-value (-log10)",
  title = "Null hypothesis comparison for all cluster pathways") + 
  theme_bw()

outfile <- "enrichment_null_comparison_pvals.pdf"
pdf(file = outfile,
    width = unit(6, "in"),
    height = unit(6, "in"))
print(plt_null_pvals)
invisible(dev.off())
```

```{r}
  filter(Title == pathway) |> 
  pull(ID) |> 
  unique()

df_pathway_pvals <- inner_join(
  mat_enrichment_pvals[idx_pathway,] |> 
    enframe(name = "cluster_id", value = "pvals_HG"),
  permutation_pvals[idx_pathway,] |> 
    enframe(name = "cluster_id", value = "pvals_permute"), 
  by = "cluster_id"
)

  left_join(df_mouse_cluster_labels, by = "cluster_id") |> 
  select(-cluster_id, cluster_id = cluster_id_new)

df_pathway_pvals <- df_pathway_pvals |> 
  separate(col = "cluster_id", into = c("nk", "k"), remove = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(nk = factor(as.numeric(nk)))


plt_null_wnt <- ggplot(df_pathway_pvals, 
                       aes(x = -log10(pvals_HG), 
                           y = -log10(pvals_permute),
                           label = cluster_id,
                           col = nk)) + 
  geom_text() +
  # geom_point(size = 2) + 
  # geom_abline(slope = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 5)) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, -log10(1/1001))) + 
  labs(x = "Hypergeometric Test p-value (-log10)",
  y = "Permutation p-value (-log10)",
  title = paste0("Null hypothesis comparison: ", pathway)) + 
  theme_bw()

outfile <- "enrichment_null_comparison_WNT.pdf"
pdf(file = outfile,
    width = unit(6, "in"),
```
